question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Elevation
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Demotion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Elevation"** means the action or fact of raising or being raised to a higher or more important level, state, or position. (उन्नति)

 

 
• **Example: **His elevation to the position of CEO was a result of his hard work and dedication.

 

 

 
• **"Demotion" **refers to the action of reducing someone to a lower rank or less senior position. (अवनति)

 

 
• **Example: **After the mistake, he faced demotion from his managerial post to a regular staff position.

 

 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'elevation' **is **'demotion'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Demotion**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Promotion **(प्रचार ): The action of raising someone to a higher rank or position.

 

 
• **Example:** She received a promotion for her exceptional work performance.

 

 

 
• **Creation **(सृजन ): The action or process of bringing something into existence.

 

 
• **Example: ** The creation of new technologies has transformed the modern world.

 

 

 
• **Presentation** (प्रस्तुति): The act of presenting something, such as a new idea or product, to an audience.

 

 
• **Example:** Her presentation on climate change was both informative and engaging.
